summary: Announced 3 February 2026: a Green Paper proposing fundamental water system reform, including a dedicated Welsh economic regulator for water, new legislation, and 5 million pounds in 2026-27 for enforcement and river improvement. The consultation closed on 7 April 2026; a summary of responses and next steps is awaited, and the Welsh Government signalled a White Paper to follow subject to the post-election government's agreement and the enactment of UK primary legislation.
title: Green Paper: Shaping the Future of Water Governance in Wales
